title: STRONGHOLD PROTOCOL OPEN
lines: DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing [Key Objectives] missions and Daily Goals to claim [Stronghold Credits], and raise [Stronghold Credit] levels to receive rewards.
REWARDS: EPOQUE - Sun Slant for Diamante, Event Icon 'Ship', Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, etc.

- Daily Goal: Players can obtain [Stronghold Credits] every day through the simulation. Once reached a certain amount, a bonus [Stronghold Credit] reward will be available at the completion screen. This reward can be claimed once per day, refreshing daily at 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Please stay tuned for more details.
02 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting [Joint Operation] opens, and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6★ and 5★ Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Ulpianus / Dorothy / Pozëmka / Executor the Ex Foedere
★★★★★: Proviso / Santalla / Mitm / Aroma / Ashlock / Aurora
Please stay tuned for more information!
